question:
The relation R defined on the set N of natural number by
$x\ Ry \Leftrightarrow 2x^{2} - 3xy + y^{2} = 0$ is
solution:
(i)
$xRx \Leftrightarrow 2x^{2} - 3x \cdot x + x^{2} = 0\forall x \in \mathbb{N}$
R is reflexive.
(ii) for x=1, y=2
$2x^{2} - 3xy + y^{2} = 2 \times 1 - 3 \times 1 \times 2 + 4 = 2 - 6 + 4 = 0$
But for y=1, x=2
$2x^{2} - 3xy + y^{2} = 2x(2)^{2} - 3 \times 1 \times 2 + (1)^{2} = 8 - 6 + 1 = 3 \neq 0$
So 1 R 2 but 2 not R 1
So R is not symmetric.

question:
A spherical balloon is filled with $4500_{\pi}$ cubic meters of
helium gas. If a leak in the balloon causes the gas to escape at the
rate of $72_{\pi}$ cubic meters per minute then the rate (in meters per
minute) at which the radius of the balloon decreases 49 minutes after
the leakage began is
solution:
Let r be the radius of the balloon and V be its volume. It is
given that
$\frac{dV}{dt} = - 72\pi$
$\frac{d}{dt}\left( \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} \right) = - 72\pi \Rightarrow \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} = - 72\pi t + C$
When $t = 0,\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} = C = 4500\pi$
$\therefore\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} = 4500\pi - 72\pi t$
When $t = 49,\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} = 4500\pi - (72\pi)(49) = 972\pi$
$\Rightarrow$ r^3 = 729  so  r = 9
Also $\frac{d}{dt}\left( \frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3} \right) = - 72\pi$
$\Rightarrow 4\pi r^{2}\frac{dr}{dt} = - 72\pi$
$\Rightarrow \frac{dr}{dt} = - \frac{72\pi}{4\pi r^{2}} = - \frac{18}{r^{2}}$.
 So ${\frac{dr}{dt}|}_{r = 9} = - \frac{2}{9}$.

question:
In $\Delta$ABC internal angle bisectors AI, BI and CI are
produced to meet opposite sides in C', respectively.
Find the maximum value of
$\frac{27(AI \times BI \times CI)}{{AA}^{'} \times {BB}^{'} \times {CC}^{'}}$
solution:
Since angle bisector divides opposite sides in ratio of sides
containing the angle, hence
${BA}^{'} = \frac{ac}{b + c},{CA}^{'} = \frac{ab}{b + c}$
now BI is also an angle bisector of $\angle$B for triangle ABA'.
$\therefore\frac{AI}{A^{'}I} = \frac{b + c}{a} \Rightarrow \frac{AI}{{AA}^{'}} = \frac{b + c}{a + b + c}$
Similarly,
$\frac{BI}{{BB}^{'}} = \frac{a + c}{a + b + c}$ and
$\frac{CI}{{CC}^{'}} = \frac{a + b}{a + b + c}$
$\Rightarrow \frac{AI \times BI \times CI}{AA^{'} \times BB^{'} \times CC^{'}} = \frac{(a + b)(b + c)(c + a)}{(a + b + c)^{3}}$
Using A.M. $\geq$ G.M. we get
$\frac{2(a + b + c)}{3(a + b + c)} \geq \left\lbrack \frac{(a + b)(b + c)(c + a)}{(a + b + c)^{3}} \right\rbrack^{\frac{1}{3}}$
$\Rightarrow \frac{(a + b)(b + c)(c + a)}{(a + b + c)^{3}} \leq \frac{8}{27}$
$\therefore$ maximum value
$\frac{27(AI \times BI \times CI)}{{AA}^{'} \times {BB}^{'} \times {CC}^{'}} = 8$
subject: Mathematics
